title: testing-sheet-run/1
description: The last line of stdout of `testing sheets run ... --result` (docs/SHEETS.md): what ran and what was written, for a program that started the run. The exit code is 1 for a red sheet and for a task that could not be written alike; `red` and `written` tell the two apart. A run that was refused or could not start (exit 2, or 3 before a sheet ran) prints no document. Texts carry no control characters and no more than about 300 characters. A reader ignores unknown fields and refuses a higher schema.

exit.description: The exit code of the command: 0 green and written, 1 a sheet is red or a task was not written, 3 the engine of tasks.nvim could not be reached or the Result-IR not written.

task.description: The task of `--task`; null for `--all` and `--sheet`.

sheets.description: The sheets of the run, in the order they ran.

red.description: A sheet is red: it failed or does not load; under `--strict` a skipped sheet too.

tasks.description: With `--tasks`: what became of the block of each task. Empty without it.

written.description: Whether every task's block stands as the run left it (`changed`, `unchanged`; `would_change` under `--dry-run`). false: at least one was not written, or tasks.nvim could not be reached (`problem`). null: nothing was to be written (no `--tasks`).

problem.description: Why no task could be written at all (exit 3).

id.description: The id of the sheet; of a sheet that does not load, its file below the root.

status.description: skip: it could not run here (no browser, a live sheet without --live); a sheet that waits for a person's judgement is pass.

outcome.description: changed, unchanged, would_change (a dry run): the block stands. failed (a conflict, a refusal, broken markers), missing (not an open task), truncated (not read, or too long to send back): it does not. A reader takes any other word as not written.

message.description: The reason of an outcome that is not written.
